classification.difficultyReason: Calculate one smaller cube's surface area, multiply by eight, and form the original-to-total ratio while accounting for the squared edge scale.

content.prompt: A cube of edge length $a$ is sliced three ways to create eight cubes of dimensions $\dfrac a2\times\dfrac a2\times\dfrac a2$. Find the ratio of the surface area of the original cube to the total surface area of the eight cubes.

spec.description: Unshaded perspective cube with each visible front, top and right face divided into a 2 by 2 grid. Hidden edges are omitted.
spec.mathematics: Three perpendicular central cuts produce eight cubes of edge a/2; all visible subdivision junctions are retained.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied subdivision is visible; no calculated surface areas or ratio.

answer.short:
$1:2$.

The eight smaller cubes have twice the original total surface area.
